name: FREE This Old Book Puzzle Swap
location: This Old Book, 138 Center St, Grayslake IL 60030
raw: FREE This Old Book Puzzle Swap, Saturday December 19 2026, 10 AM-5:30 PM, 138 Center St, Grayslake. Public event on Facebook by This Old Book (independent bookstore). Wondering what to do with those puzzles you've completed? SWAP THEM! Bring your puzzles to exchange with others for FREE!
notes: Free drop-in puzzle swap at the bookstore: bring a completed puzzle and trade it for another. Open all day.
